topMovers.shortDescription: BerriAI LiteLLM contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow any authenticated user, including holders of low-privilege internal-user keys, to run arbitrary commands on the host.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: PaperCut NG/MF Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: PaperCut NG/MF contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-82078.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: JetBrains TeamCity Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft SharePoint Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Microsoft SharePoint Server contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.

PaperCut NG/MF contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate system configuration parameters and execute arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-81578.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Identity Services Engine Injection Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Cisco Identity Services Engine contains an injection vulnerability in a specific API of Cisco ISE and Cisco ISE-PIC due to insufficient validation of user-supplied input allowing an attacker to exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted API request. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to perform remote code execution and obtaining root privileges on an affected device.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain a buffer overflow vulnerability in ImageIO when processing a maliciously crafted image, which may lead to code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2023-41061.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Google Chromium V8 Engine contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

topMovers.vulnerabilityName: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
topMovers.shortDescription: Apple iOS, iPadOS, and macOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Image I/O framework.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.
Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

highestSignals.vulnerabilityName: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
highestSignals.shortDescription: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

observations: CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days.
Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4).
Citrix has the most new KEV entries this week (2).
CVE-2026-42271 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 753 positions.
executiveSummary: CISA added 10 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Other is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (4). Citrix has the most new KEV entries this week (2). CVE-2026-42271 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 753 positions.
